html: Our paper "VLC Fusion: Vision-Language Conditioned Sensor Fusion for Robust Object Detection" was accepted to ECML PKDD'26 and shortlisted for the Best Research Track Student Paper Award 🎗.
Joined Bosch as a Research Intern.
Our paper "ExpressivityBench: Can LLMs Communicate Implicitly?" was accepted to Findings of EACL'26.
Our paper "Consistency-based Abductive Reasoning over Perceptual Errors of Multiple Pre-trained Models in Novel Environments" was accepted to AAAI'26.
Our paper "BaTCAVe: Trustworthy Explanations for Robot Behaviors" was accepted to IROS'25.
Joined Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory as a Student Research Intern in the MIG group.
Our paper "Explainable Concept Generation through Vision-Language Preference Learning for Understanding Neural Networks' Internal Representations" was accepted to ICML'25.
Joined Arizona State University as a PhD student in Computer Science.
Presented four workshop papers at NeurIPS'24.

Our paper "Failures Are Fated, But Can Be Faded: Characterizing and Mitigating Unwanted Behaviors in Large-Scale Vision and Language Models" was accepted to ICML'24 as a spotlight-designated paper 🎗 (top 3.5%).
Joined Arizona State University as a Masters student in Computer Science.
